title: The Most Violent 13 Year Old Ever (Police Bodycam)
description:
On March 10th, 2022, officers responded to an altercation between two students at a school. One of the female students was behaving aggressively and arguing with staff members. The female was soon transported to jail. The female was charged with battery upon a peace officer.
